description: This file defines a public enum `BonjourServiceResolverSupport` with static utility methods to assist in resolving Bonjour network services and normalizing host names. It provides functions to start service resolution with a timeout and to clean up host strings.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Schedules the service in the main run loop and initiates resolution with a specified timeout.

methods.name: normalizeHost
methods.description: Trims whitespace and newlines from the input string, and removes a trailing dot if present, to normalize the host name.
